name: OneIG-Bench
intro: OneIG-Bench 是面向文生图模型的双语细粒度基准，五个英文提示集合及其中文核验版本覆盖动漫与风格、人像、通用物体、文本渲染和知识推理，中文发布集另含多语种集合；论文和固定代码分别定义了五维自动评测及其可运行实现。
build_method: 真实提示整理, 场景与语义聚类平衡, 聚类中心余弦去重, GPT-4o按Beta分布改写长度, 人工审核, 中文翻译核验与多语种补充
metric: 语义对齐；文本分数（编辑距离、完成率、词准确率复合）；知识推理相似度；双编码器风格分数；DreamSim多样性
language: 英文, 中文, 多语言
eval_feature: 五维自动评测, 中英文对比, 提示类型与长度细分分析
build_method_en: Real-world Prompt Curation, Scene and Semantic Clustering, Cluster-center Cosine Deduplication, GPT-4o Beta-distributed Length Rewriting, Manual Review, Verified Chinese Translation and Multilingual Supplement
eval_feature_en: Five-dimensional Automated Evaluation, English-Chinese Comparison, Prompt-type and Length Analysis
intro_en: OneIG-Bench is a bilingual fine-grained benchmark for text-to-image models. Five English prompt sets and their verified Chinese counterparts cover anime and stylization, portraits, general objects, text rendering, and knowledge and reasoning; the Chinese release adds a multilingual set. The paper and fixed code snapshot define the five-dimensional automated protocol and its runnable implementation, respectively.
scale_en: 2,440 prompt records: 1,120 English prompts (245 anime, 244 portrait, 206 object, 200 text, 225 reasoning) and a 1,320-row Chinese release (1,120 counterparts plus 200 multilingual prompts)
metric_en: Semantic alignment; composite text score from edit distance, completion rate and word accuracy; knowledge-reasoning similarity; dual-encoder style score; DreamSim diversity

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-22; source_kind=primary_paper_and_fixed_official_code_and_data. Paper: arXiv:2506.07977v3, Sections 3.1-3.2 and 4.1 plus Appendix A; PDF SHA-256 d23bb2e1d69d85fa3da3b6a48bfdfc037909b1893bcc1eabdb35a67c691e8c5a. Official project page: https://oneig-bench.github.io/. Fixed code: https://github.com/OneIG-Bench/OneIG-Benchmark/tree/41b49831e79e6dde5323618c164da1c4cf0f699d (commit date 2026-02-10, message 'support mxn evaluation'); README SHA-256 4e25bd6ca601b427d0f87ccb490964f9d56f28b3037655215d30d1551a1bb035; English CSV SHA-256 e06c65b32252d82406fb1a27f13022b38d432c899a2486eb49ab0c100f83b3e1; Chinese CSV SHA-256 8fc4ae1403db32dbb1203cc457361c3215500b34e741194a53f5002c9d824700; alignment/text/reasoning/style/diversity script SHA-256 values 4438d58983db71730b5f6c809b2142b0c6d0e964989e5ceb7d7dc3d6d1b8da, 76a9e5d87b47aa85f935c7a605700cbbf1e0c7b29007514af8743f051ee96f4e, ffdf10bf28161242fcfcaf8d91f2682c045e02163ce9291e31c685927bb1df41, bf0c7d968732a6912816dec2c1a0d59f1c59cd5ff8a7ab505fa21bcc8b8b0009, and cdcc29472f5f1143f2c50818ba9b2233a56a551d83d4845886ce9a71751d928c. Fixed public dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/OneIG-Bench/OneIG-Bench/tree/f80e6317806bf0b1d92da3113633a62451b0fd4f; English JSON SHA-256 fdbb075cb06d1d475583c5db373427327b20853914361b5757cf99573b06792d; Chinese JSON SHA-256 d07b6abc252368f3f46a3985d742c92b0c1531bcac5d547fe12ae9e04b2118cc. Verified counts are 1,120 English rows (245 Anime_Stylization, 244 Portrait, 206 General_Object, 200 Text_Rendering, 225 Knowledge_Reasoning) and 1,320 Chinese rows with the same five sets plus 200 Multilingualism rows, hence 2,440 records rather than 1,120 paired objects. Section 3.2 internally says five core steps while Figure 2's caption says four methodical steps; the prose supports four method groups—collection, clustering plus deduplication, rewriting, and human review—so the diagram separates clustering and deduplication for readability without inventing a fifth paper stage. The paper construction is public-internet/user/dataset curation, scene-semantic clustering, cluster-center cosine deduplication, approximate 1:2:1 short/medium/long rewriting by GPT-4o using Beta(2.37,2.86), and manual sensitive/conflicting-semantic review; translation verification and the extra multilingual set belong to the release description, not a fifth construction stage. Paper metrics are DSG alignment, the ED/CR/WAC composite text score with phi=100 EN and 50 ZH, GPT-4o-answer plus LLM2CLIP reasoning, mean of CSD and OneIG-style maximum-reference similarities, and one-minus DreamSim similarity diversity. The fixed code loads precomputed question/dependency and answer JSON instead of regenerating them with GPT-4o; it expects one grid image per prompt and splits m-by-n cells (README image_grid=2 means four images), implements ancestor dependency gating, and uses DreamSim's distance output, corresponding to the paper's one-minus-similarity interpretation. Openness boundary: the HF data card declares CC BY-NC 4.0 and is publicly downloadable at the pinned revision; the fixed Git tree contains no LICENSE file and requires external model checkpoints, so dataset access must not be generalized to a code license. The project leaderboard continued to add models after paper v3; those updates are not changes to the fixed paper protocol. EN labels were checked for Chinese characters; ZH nodes carry Chinese semantics; all source-boundary edges are secondary and explicitly dashed; formal drawio/arch/svg/png assets were intentionally not regenerated at source stage. Formal publication evidence [site-a12b-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2132×481 (English) and 2127×481 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2130×479 and 2125×479. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
